item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Several people are injured at Berlin's LGBTQ+ march after a car drives into the crowd
item.description: A car drove into a crowd during Berlin's famed LGBTQ+ parade on Saturday and injured several people, prompting police to call off the event in the German capital hours after it had begun. Police said some of the victims had life-threatening injuries.
